about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Matthias the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who didst choose thy blessed servant Matthias to be of the number of the twelve Apostles, grant, we beseech thee, that, through his intercession, we may always feel the tenderness of Thy mercy toward us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
